findings.evidence: engine.py step 3d iterates holdings without recording the ticker; _holdings_from_yaml accepts duplicates; the MAE step has the same pre-existing behaviour.
findings.repro: propose([Holding('T',.03), Holding('T',.02)], [], ips, 'us', ratings_held={'T': Sell}) -> 2 DECIDE cards
findings.acceptance: one DECIDE per ticker regardless of duplicate rows (loader-level duplicate check covers MAE too).
findings.resolution: pre-existing loader behaviour shared with the MAE step; DRAFT-70

findings.claim: A rating with surrounding whitespace is accepted by the MCP ledger writer but ignored by the veto (and by book's VETO check).
findings.evidence: mcp_server.py validates rating.strip().lower() but writes the raw string; schema._rank lowercases without strip.
findings.acceptance: normalise once at the ledger boundary.
